_comment: DEVTEST role map. One port = one role = one signed-in identity.
There is no sign-in screen anywhere in this build: the port decides who you are.
Edit a row and restart that port to change identity.

ports.label: Clinic Owner
ports.sees: Everything in the clinic: staff, settings, billing, audit, all doctors' queues

ports.label: Receptionist
ports.sees: Front desk: issue tokens, call, complete, patients, appointments, reports. Cannot set clinical priority

ports.label: Doctor
ports.sees: Own queue only: start session, call, complete, set priority with a reason. No token issuing, no other doctors' patients

ports.label: Platform Admin
ports.sees: All tenants: clinics, plans, feature gates, payment verification, groups, support queue

ports.label: Clinic Owner (2nd clinic)
ports.sees: Same role as 8080 but a different tenant — proves isolation: never sees Serenity's patients
